title: The Shining
synopsis: A winter caretaker, an empty hotel, a boy on a tricycle, and a corridor that has been waiting for the right family.

nodes.text: Mr. Ullman across a desk and a story about a previous caretaker. Both choices lead to Tour, but “Accept” arrives there with a different cost than “Refuse.” By Tour, the danger will have learned what you protect first.

choices.consequence: You commit to accept. It carries you into Tour while the safer possibility closes without making a sound.
You refuse. The way toward Tour opens, and something on the other side seems to notice.

nodes.text: Two sets of footprints in, one set out, a heartbeat slowing in the dark. “Sit down” opens the route to Spring at the Overlook. “Get up” changes the terms and carries you toward Snowcat South. A third choice, “Take the third path,” keeps Hallorann Hires a Cook in play.

You commit to get up. It carries you into Snowcat South while the safer possibility closes without making a sound.
Some endings reveal themselves last. You take the third path. The way toward Hallorann Hires a Cook opens, and something on the other side seems to notice.

nodes.text: Tradesmen find an axe by the boiler and a manuscript in a typewriter and a photograph in the lobby that nobody can quite explain. The road into Spring at the Overlook began with “Sit down” in Maze, Center; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

Wendy at the wheel and Danny in the passenger seat. They roll out of the gates and never come back, not even for the manuscript. The road into Snowcat South began with “Get up” in Maze, Center; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

He drives away from the Overlook with a small boy and a half-broken wife and he teaches the boy to read recipes, and the shine, slowly, becomes a small private gift. The road into Hallorann Hires a Cook began with “Take the third path” in Maze, Center; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.
